text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's so-so, I guess. You need to practice 
running physics calculations in your head 
more.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: An' what're we gonna do with this plushie?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I don't need this. ...Not like I can 
just toss it out, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, there'll probably be someone back at 
the Academy who wants it. So hold onto it 
till we get back.
